# input n48000.wav = python3 sig.py gen noise n48000.wav --sr 48000 --db -30 --secs 10 ; analysis = sig.welch_tf nfft=32768 hann 75% ov, skipping first 0.5s, +-3% band mean, minus flat baseline (all knobs default); code: h.py eqp.py in same dir

# ids: 48 LowFreq(0..3=20,30,60,100) 49 LFBoost 50 LFAtten 51 HighFreq(0..6=3,4,5,8,10,12,16k) 52 HFBoost 53 HFQ(0 sharp..1 broad) 54 HFAttenFreq(0..2=5,10,20k) 55 HFAtten 56 Enable 57 Output. ## trick features (both): dip = min over 5-1000Hz, bump = max over 5-1000
